apiAlignment: 04A V7 (2026-11-07): INVALID_STATE, INVALID_ARGUMENT, UNSUPPORTED_SNAPSHOT_VERSION added; ErrorStage.UNKNOWN is the fallback for unknown stages. M4-B2 (2026-11-08): AVATAR_NO_FACE, AVATAR_IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED appended (04A E6). VK-A2 (2026-11-08): FEATURE_DISABLED, FEATURE_DENIED appended (REQ-API-10).
description: VideoKit stable error code registry (04 §9.1, 02 §4.0.2). Kotlin ErrorCode and Dart ErrorCode are verified against this file. 'stage' is the typical stage; an error may also be reported from other stages. 'retryable' and 'suggestedAction' are the defaults the runtime uses. Unknown codes must be handled as 'unknownCodeFallback'. New codes are a minor API version change and are appended at the end. 'params' (optional) registers the message parameter keys of a code (VideoKitStableError.params, 13 §3.1): values are strings formatted with Locale.ROOT; a parameter may be absent, and unknown keys are ignored.

params.codec: Optional (04A X2). Codec MIME type as the media declares it, for example video/hevc or audio/eac3.
params.profile: Optional (04A X2). Codec profile as the media declares it (RFC 6381 codecs string or profile name), for example hvc1.2.4.L120 or Main 10.
params.bitDepth: Optional (04A X2). Luma bit depth, decimal integer, for example 10.
params.container: Optional (04A X2). Container MIME type, for example video/x-matroska.
params.reasonDetail: Optional (04A X2). Why it is not supported, upper snake case: FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED (no decoder for this format), EXCEEDS_CAPABILITIES (a decoder exists but not for this profile, level, size or bit depth), CONTAINER_UNSUPPORTED. Unknown values are shown generically.

params.requiredBytes: Optional. Additional bytes that must be freed (estimated output size minus known free space, or the shortfall a host sink reported), decimal integer > 0. Present only when known; the UI rounds it up to 10 MB, otherwise shows the generic free-space text (UI-AUDIT-A1 J8).

params.reason: Optional (04A X1). Why the export worker failed: WORKER_KILLED (the system or the main process killed it, for example low memory), WORKER_CRASHED (it crashed: native signal, uncaught exception, out of memory), WORKER_TIMEOUT (no progress within the watchdog time). Absent for other export failures; unknown values are shown as a generic export failure.

codes.description: REQ-ED-07, 04A E6 (M4-B2): no usable face in the avatar image; the user picks another photo.
REQ-ED-07, 04A E6 (M4-B2): the avatar image cannot be decoded or exceeds the size limit (also a host-supplied PNG).

REQ-API-10 (VK-A2): the feature is hidden by the host configuration (FeatureMode.HIDDEN). Also reported from BIND (multi-view), TRACKING and EXPORT. The UI normally shows no entry; this is the answer of a direct API call.

params.feature: VideoKitFeature wire name: MULTI_VIEW, EDIT, MASK_TRACKING, AVATAR or EXPORT. Unknown values are shown generically.

codes.description: REQ-API-10 (VK-A2): the host's feature gate (checkFeature) did not allow the feature, or the gate callback failed or timed out. The host handles the user side (for example its paywall); retrying may succeed once the host allows. Also reported from BIND (multi-view), TRACKING and EXPORT.

params.feature: VideoKitFeature wire name, as for FEATURE_DISABLED.
params.badge: Optional. FeatureBadge wire name the host gave: LOCK or TRIAL. Unknown values are drawn as no marker.
